designs.A: Production Core source, unmodified; current adaptive substeps/parameters/order
designs.B: Diagnostic T1 + Node plane order + Node plane properties; T1 factorial winner, not actual Node executable
designs.C: TOI replacing Core tick cycle, current profile properties/current order
designs.D: TOI + Core order + Node plane properties (P effect vs C)
designs.E: TOI + Node plane order + Core properties (O effect vs C)
designs.F: TOI + Node plane order + Node properties

limitations: TOI is a diagnostic clone, not Node equivalence. It keeps Core's old-velocity motion and tick-end gravity/damping.
Candidate acceptance records valid candidates at each selected event; rejected candidates are counted by reason, not retained individually.
Simultaneous contacts are processed one at a time and re-detected, not solved as a contact manifold; wall/net overlap can chatter.
T1 and archived Node comparisons cover ball trajectories; archived Node was not rerun and the current output is not proof of official Haxball behavior.
Controls are 20 ticks; A-F are 20 ticks, and the original A-F Node comparison was a one-tick historical check.
Analytic line-segment sweep plus conservative arc search; no exhaustion seen in executed cases, but arc method has a 96-advance cap.

nodeReference.run: archived captured oracle reused; not rerun

rules.finite: No negative time; time clamped to [0,remaining]; cap 32 events, then move remaining time with current velocity and set eventLimit diagnostic.
rules.overlap: Initial penetration is corrected at t=0; approaching touching contacts are accepted at t=0; separating/tangent contacts are discarded. Re-detect after every event.
rules.tiePolicy: Earliest t; values within 1e-9 tie, then rank by mode, geometry/disc insertion index, stable ID. Core mode ranks pair,bounds,plane,segment; Node-style diagnostic ranks plane,segment,pair,bounds.

node.processing: archived Node trace resolves outer top then ball-area top
